_: Host normalisation vectors shared by backend/core/deployment.py::host_of and cli/src/mvp/sso.rs::audience_host (contract:C6.11). Every case names the host both implementations must produce for the same URL, so a bound sign-in agrees on the audience rather than disagreeing per language. Read by backend/tests/test_deployment.py and cli/src/mvp/sso.rs's own test module.
_known_divergent_residual: Legacy IPv4 shorthand ('127.1', '0x7f.1', a bare decimal integer) is not covered here: Python's `ipaddress.ip_address` refuses all of these (strict 4-octet dotted-decimal only), so `core.deployment.host_of` falls through to the hostname/IDNA branch and reads '127.1' as the two-label hostname it looks like, not as 127.0.0.1. Whether the CLI's `url` crate (whose IPv4 parser follows the WHATWG URL standard, which DOES accept shorthand forms and expands them) agrees is unverified -- adding it here as an equality case would be a vector asserting a behaviour neither side has confirmed. No real STRATOCLAVE_API_ENDPOINT/STRATOCLAVE_STS_AUDIENCES value is expected to use shorthand IPv4; this is recorded as a known gap, not fixed.
